text: alexs-macbook-pro is an M4 with 16GB RAM: two sessions running heavy tests at once (vitest workers + e2e next dev servers + next build) pushed it into ~16GB swap with multi-second lockups on 10-9, so serialize heavy test runs across sessions; jobsnearme vitest is now capped at maxWorkers 4 (VITEST_MAX_WORKERS overrides) and VS Code excludes **/.claude/worktrees/** from watching.
